title: Report to governor.
bodyText: At the end of each license year, the board of agriculture and biosecurity shall submit to the governor a report relating to the activities of the milk control program.
bodyHtml:
§157-18  Report to governor.  At the end of each license year, the board of agriculture and biosecurity shall submit to the governor a report relating to the activities of the milk control program. [L 1967, c 260, §11; HRS §157-18; am L 1986, c 61, §2; am L 2025, c 236, §18]

 

Cross References

 

  Annual reports, see §93-12.
